name: cosmic-portal
title: Cosmic Portal
blurb: Animated 3D cosmic portal with rotating crystals, bloom effects, and shifting…
description: Renders a Three.js WebGL scene with a rotating crystal portal, procedurally-generated geometry, and post-processing bloom. Colors and complexity are customizable. Includes ref methods to activate or shift dimensions.
use_when: Hero sections or feature showcases needing an immersive, otherworldly visual impact.
avoid_when: Performance-critical contexts, mobile devices, or when color schemes must stay static.
a11y: Purely visual 3D scene. Buttons for activation are keyboard-accessible. No audio or interaction beyond controls.
